rules.sentence: Nodular fasciitis: It is associated with prior history of breast injury.
Microscopy findings are notable for bland fibroblastic/myofibroblastic cells with variable cellularity in a tissue culture pattern.
There is a myxoid stroma with extravasated red blood cells, stromal lymphocytes, and giant cells.
Immunohistochemistry is negative for CD34 and positive for SMA, focal desmin, and nuclear Rb.
Molecular analysis is positive for USP6 rearrangement, and MYH9 is the most common fusion partner.[46][47]
On histology, epithelial components or epithelioid cells can be present, associated with high nuclear grade, and frequent mitosis in high-grade cases.
This tumor is infiltrative and encases normal breast ducts, commonly with stromal lymphocytes.
Immunohistochemistry is positive for cytokeratins, p63, and negative for estrogen receptors, progesterone receptors, and desmin.
Genetic alterations involving PTEN, TP53, and EGFR have been reported.[48]
This is notable for single files of low-grade dyscohesive cells, cytoplasmic vacuoles with absent spindle cells, and infiltrative borders.
Atypical lobular hyperplasia and lobular carcinoma in situ can be present.
Cells are positive for estrogen receptors, progesterone receptors, E-cadherin, cytokeratins, and GCDFP-15.
